metadata.title: Tailor-made multiple sequence alignments using the PRALINE 2 alignment toolkit
metadata.abstract: PRALINE 2 is a toolkit for custom multiple sequence alignment workflows. It can be used to incorporate sequence annotations, such as secondary structure or (DNA) motifs, into the alignment scoring, as well as to customize many other aspects of a progressive multiple alignment workflow.
